lead.en: Host-provided notes, decisions, citations and action items.
lead.zh: 展示宿主提供的会议摘要、决定、引用和行动事项。

rule.en: The host provides notes, runs regeneration and sends actions; the example simulates sends. Copy writes to the real clipboard and reports success or failure. The preview offers Live, Error, and No transcript. Use MeetingStatus::NoTranscript for a missing transcript.
rule.zh: 宿主提供纪要、执行重新生成及发送行动项；示例发送为模拟。复制使用真实剪贴板并报告成功或失败。 预览提供正常、错误和无转录。宿主用 MeetingStatus::NoTranscript 表示没有转录。

api.en: Handle Send, then finish_send with its ticket. Pending sends are deduplicated and cancelled when data changes. Timestamp buttons expose source quotes; Escape closes a quote.
api.zh: 处理 Send 并以 ticket 调用 finish_send；发送中防重复，内容变化时取消待处理发送。时间按钮展开原文，Esc 关闭引用。

motion.en: States update immediately. Streaming, quote hover intent and detailed transitions are not yet implemented or visually verified.
motion.zh: 状态当前立即更新；流式呈现、悬停意图及细节动效尚未实现或完成视觉验收。
